Everything is cheaper, more efficient, and more available than ever, yet somehow your flights, your vet bills, your search results, and your entire Tuesday feel like they’ve gone to absolute shit. In this video, I break down the four mechanisms quietly enshittifying modern life and why you can be one of the luckiest humans in history while still feeling like you’re drowning.
